Source declarations require later applicability/review before execution and confer no approval. Full files enter a NEW charged turn; no reading is credited to this response.

texts.context_assessment: Assess the complete original obligation→quantity/method/source mapping and typed scientific context in public_case. Preserve nonnumeric deliverables and unknowns. Check whether proposed tests can discriminate mechanisms, units/normalizations/source applicability, calibration needs and omitted data. Send back unsupported methods or narrowed scope. texts.next_action: Choose the NEXT useful source-backed research action from complete current search/evidence state. Design experiments/baselines/ablations/controls that distinguish rivals rather than repeating an uninformative fit or enlarging a failed job blindly. Preserve full original task, uncertainty, negative evidence and cost. source-context arguments are {modes:exact source catalogue mode IDs,artifacts:optional exact prepared pins}; an empty modes list is allowed only with nonempty committed prepared selections. Only returned full source bodies become normal inputs in a later charged turn, never a read credit from the inventory. experiment arguments are {study:complete ordinary schema2 JSON,experiment:research_cycle fields excluding study,source_mapping:complete original obligation→method/quantity/source mapping, records:optional authored JSON configurations [{id,purpose:prospective_configuration,value,source_basis:actual source pins}]}. For original private dependencies the first experiment action prepares exact study/exposure but does not admit a design. A NEW charged turn must select experiment with exactly {prepared_experiment:returned pin}, after receiving the whole inventory/config while private bodies remain withheld. Generated references are exactly {generated_record:id,field:path|sha256|pin2|pin3}. Model-authored JSON is NOT measured covariance/calibration/cross section or retrieved source evidence. Quantitative experiments use observable={schema_version:2,kind:quantitative,contract:pin3} and complete null categorical predictions; study.quantitative_check binds that contract and an explicit resource allocation pin before plan/approval. The fixed law, full units/covariance/exposure, named objective and unknowns enter ordinary feedback; no score supplies physics acceptance or approval. preparation-tool arguments are {action:listed preparation tool,parameters:exact public API,inputs:[{id,pin}],records:authored configuration rows}; output_dir, where required, is owned by this operation. Missing prerequisites remain actual preparation failures and should produce a better source-backed next choice. Only supplied inputs and selected existing modes may be used; every current rival needs an explicit prediction or unknown. A reviewed parent must remain the parent of a refinement. predictive-selection arguments are {experiment,graph_root,node_id} or {experiment,rundir}: bind an actual charged quantitative-predictive tool or ordinary calculation, never an invented score. run-selected has {} and uses actual affordable selector; review has {experiment,check_results:actual pin}; diagnose has {experiment,intake:failed_stage_review request}. propose has {hypotheses}; revise-premise has {identity,statement,basis,reason}; synthesize has {report_request:actual pin}; progress has {reason}. Construction/manuscript actions invoke the located exact public source API envelopes outside model dispatch; follow the catalogue transport arguments and returned shapes. Manuscript review execution/consume/finalize use its nested ordinary role_binding, retaining the outer preparation. No approval, vote, unseen result, missing event, physical response, or parent acceptance may be invented. Existing work/acceptance is scoped. Choose honest progress when a missing source/access/authority or original budget prevents another useful action. Complete the bound methodology in stage order. protocol-stage arguments are {artifact: actual source-bound stage report pin}. A missing stage blocks completion. Register every critique experiment before its stage report. Use the world digest to retain verified results and ruled-out directions. Research hypotheses include operator, identity_signature {observable,scope,prediction}, kill_condition {comparison:differs,observable}, a typed reopening_trigger {kind,field,op,value}, and what_is_new; never write status. The code-computed register and structured residuals are the next-turn evidence. Full evaluation uses adaptive cells; commit selection before confirmation and retain every trial in N. Use the protocol allocator and R1 screen receipt before dispatch. Read the research protocol record schemas for exact input contracts.
texts.failed_experiment_diagnosis: Diagnose the actual retained failure and missing quantities. Distinguish infrastructure, unsupported assumptions and physical contradictions. Propose concrete discriminating fixes/tests; preserve all failed outputs, original goal and cost. No invented successful result, vote, retry or approval.
texts.meta_review: Return a typed research_meta_review for exact subject {subject} as actor {actor}.. Use the complete source criteria and actual feedback. Report-only does not reopen evidence. Material actions name exact affected stages. Resolution must cover every open objection and preserve original criteria; never restore invalid old evidence or carry old votes.
